sprint_goal: Deliver MVP of centralized ML feature store with Feast, Redis, and Databricks providing registry, batch jobs, real-time serving, and secure access control.

tasks.title: Design Feast feature registry schema with metadata and versioning
tasks.description: Define schema for feature registry including name, owner, version, lineage, and metadata fields. Configure Feast backend on Databricks and enable version tracking.

tasks.title: Implement batch feature computation using Databricks Spark jobs
tasks.description: Create Spark jobs to compute and update features hourly and daily in Delta tables. Configure job scheduling and ensure no duplication occurs across runs.

tasks.title: Integrate Redis with Feast for real-time feature serving
tasks.description: Set up Redis cluster for online feature serving, integrate with Feast online store interface, and validate latency under 10ms (p99) for 50 feature requests.

tasks.title: Develop point-in-time correct join logic for training datasets
tasks.description: Implement feature retrieval using timestamp-based join logic to ensure data correctness and prevent leakage in training data extraction.

tasks.title: Setup feature monitoring and drift detection pipeline
tasks.description: Implement monitoring scripts to compute statistics between offline and online stores, detect drift, and trigger alerts once thresholds are exceeded.

tasks.title: Integrate Unity Catalog for team-based access control
tasks.description: Configure Unity Catalog roles and permissions to manage feature access, ensuring data security and compliance. Validate permissions in SDK and API calls.

tasks.title: Develop Python SDK and REST API for feature retrieval and management
tasks.description: Implement SDK methods and REST endpoints for feature registration, query, and monitoring. Include authentication and authorization integration.

tasks.title: Create infrastructure deployment pipeline for Feast and Redis
tasks.description: Automate infrastructure setup using DevOps scripts (Terraform/Databricks CLI). Ensure reproducibility and environment consistency across dev/stage/prod.

tasks.title: Document feature store architecture and usage guide
tasks.description: Create architecture diagrams, setup instructions, API usage examples, and onboarding documentation for data scientists and ML engineers.

risks.description: Feature serving latency may exceed 10ms under load.
risks.mitigation: Perform load testing early, optimize Redis configurations (sharding, caching), and monitor latency metrics continuously.

risks.description: Data duplication or inconsistency in batch updates could occur.
risks.mitigation: Implement idempotent Spark job logic and validation scripts to ensure consistent feature updates.

risks.description: Access control misconfiguration may expose sensitive data.
risks.mitigation: Validate Unity Catalog policies through automated tests and restrict admin privileges during initial rollout.

risks.description: Monitoring and drift detection may produce false positives.
risks.mitigation: Calibrate drift thresholds based on historical feature distributions; review alerts manually in pilot stage.

definition_of_done: All Feast registry components deployed and version control enabled.
Batch and real-time features validated with <10ms latency at p99.
Point-in-time joins verified for multiple datasets.
Access control policies configured and tested with Unity Catalog.
Feature monitoring dashboard reports drift metrics accurately.
SDK and REST API documented and tested with sample ML workflows.
Technical documentation reviewed and published in internal wiki.
